_comment: AI preset definitions, per-purpose default mappings, and platform-level provider API keys. Loaded once at app startup into the in-memory preset registry. Edits require a restart (v1 limitation; revisit when ops surfaces a real need for live reload). Every preset's `model` field is validated against config/anthropic_models.json at startup; references to unknown models fail loudly. Slugs referenced from ai_agents.preset_overrides are validated at agent save time once the registry is loaded (chunk 2). `provider_keys.anthropic` is read at boot — leave empty to disable the agent runner; the run endpoint returns 503 in that case.

presets.name: Default Sonnet
presets.description: General-purpose preset for agent reasoning and synthesis. Balanced cost/quality; the workhorse for stages that need real reasoning capability.

presets.name: Fast Haiku
presets.description: Fast, cheap preset for high-volume narrow tasks (classification, extraction, redaction). Lower temperature for more deterministic outputs.

presets.name: Fast Haiku 4.5
presets.description: Version-pinned alias for tag classification and other high-volume narrow tasks. Switch purpose_mappings to newer aliases as Haiku versions roll forward.
